Title: Event Hubs Archive in public preview

Body.Content:
Included in the many key scenarios for Azure Event Hubs are long-term data archiving and downstream micro-batch processing. Event Hubs Archive addresses these important requirements by archiving event data directly from Event Hubs to an Azure Blob storage account of your choice, with the added flexibility to specify a time or size interval. Event Hubs Archive is in public preview.

Event Hubs Archive manages all the compute and downstream processing required to pull data into Blob storage. This reduces your total cost of ownership, setup overhead, and management of custom jobs to do the same task, so you can focus on your apps.

For more information, see this blog post.
